method: Current official patriarchal, diocesan, and parish directories were used to establish Malaysian bodies. Search engines and maps were used only to discover first-party sources. No body was inferred from population, clergy visits, or an unofficial listing.

candidates.name: Current Malaysian parishes and communities of the Metropolitanate of Singapore
candidates.status: hold for a current enumerated first-party roster
candidates.reason: The metropolitan site states that Malaysia is within its territory and advertises Malaysian parishes and communities, but the current public parish page does not expose a linked or named Malaysian roster. No names were inferred from older news, maps, or independent listings.

official_jurisdiction_audit.result: Malaysia is within the Metropolitanate of Singapore, but its current site does not expose an enumerated named Malaysian roster. The unresolved roster remains held rather than inferred.
The current exarchal directory names four Malaysian parishes under the Diocese of Singapore. All four are published.
The current official external communities directory was checked and did not name a Malaysian body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
The current official diocesan and linked diaspora material was checked and did not name a Malaysian body. This records the bounded audit result, not a claim that a body could never exist.
